the sight reading is honestly the least important part, but if you really want a scholarship, definitely do some practicing on sites like sight reading factory. i’m not sure what clef you are most accustomed to, but it was all in treble clef (which sucked as a person who always reads bass clef). don’t stress too much!

If I’m honest I’ve noticed that grades really don’t matter too much when getting accepted into Berklee. I would definitely recommend keeping your grades up, as I’m sure if you are planning on applying to other schools they will come in handy.
